zh.decision_text: 【北方已定】捷报：公孙康斩袁熙袁尚，函送首级至许都。曹操北方彻底无忧。传令夏侯惇加紧宛城练兵，调配粮草辎重。另遣细作南下，刺探刘表病情及荆州虚实。同时大兴屯田于许都、邺城，充积军资——南征大计，粮草为先。

commands.reasoning: 北方平定，扩充南征兵员
邺城为河北粮仓，屯田备南征

en.decision_text: The north is pacified. Gongsun Kang has executed Yuan Xi and Yuan Shang, sending their heads to Xuchang. Cao Cao's rear is secure. Xiahou Dun accelerates troop training at Wancheng while supplies are stockpiled. Agents probe Liu Biao's illness and Jingzhou's defenses. Agricultural colonies expand at Xuchang and Ye to fill the granaries.

commands.reasoning: Ye is the northern granary, fill it for the campaign

zh.decision_text: 【卧龙出山】诸葛亮已出山辅佐刘备。在隆中草庐之中，孔明为刘备剖析天下大势：「曹操拥百万之众，挟天子以令诸侯，此诚不可与争锋。孙权据有江东，已历三世，国险而民附，此可与为援而不可图也。将军若跨有荆益，保其岩阻，西和诸戎，南抚夷越，外结好孙权，内修政理——则霸业可成，汉室可兴矣。」

commands.reasoning: 孔明治新野，兴修水利开垦荒地
遣诸葛亮赴江东探孙权之意

en.decision_text: The Sleeping Dragon has emerged. Zhuge Liang lays out his Longzhong Plan: Cao Cao commands a million men and holds the Emperor — he cannot be directly challenged. Sun Quan holds Jiangdong through three generations — he can be an ally but not a target. Liu Bei must seize Jing and Yi provinces, ally with Sun Quan, pacify the southern tribes, and reform governance. Then the Han may be restored.

commands.reasoning: Send Zhuge Liang to probe Sun Quan's intentions

zh.decision_text: 【联刘抗曹】孙权闻曹操整军南征之意，召群臣廷议。鲁肃进言：「曹操若南下，必先取荆州，再图江东。刘备屯新野、领江夏，得诸葛亮辅佐，可结为唇齿，共抗曹操。」孙权从之——遣鲁肃赴江夏与刘备定盟，命周瑜在柴桑整训水师以备北来，张昭坐镇建业稳固后方。

commands.reasoning: 扩建水师应对北方威胁
加固柴桑水寨，巩固江防
鲁肃赴江夏与刘备定盟共抗曹操

en.decision_text: Sun Quan hears of Cao Cao's looming southern campaign and convenes his council. Lu Su counsels: should Cao Cao march south, he will take Jingzhou first, then threaten Jiangdong. Liu Bei holds Xinye and Jiangxia and has gained Zhuge Liang — he can be a vital ally against Cao. Sun Quan agrees — Lu Su travels to Jiangxia to seal an alliance with Liu Bei, while Zhou Yu drills the fleet at Chaisang and Zhang Zhao stabilizes the home front.

commands.reasoning: Fortify the Chaisang naval fortress and river defenses
Lu Su seals an alliance with Liu Bei at Jiangxia against Cao Cao
